exposure: caesarean section in first stage of labor
caesarean section in second stage of labor
cohort: 300 pregnant women aged 18 years or older with pregnancies at or beyond 37 weeks gestation, singleton fetus in vertex presentation, admitted to the labor room and undergoing caesarean delivery.
finding: Caesarean section in the second stage of labor is associated with higher maternal and perinatal morbidity and increased neonatal mortality compared to caesarean section in the first stage of labor.
